blind_target.evidence_quote: In this project, we have discussed the replication of “Generative adversarial Transformers” by Hudson and Zitnick [2].
blind_target.outcome_computational_quote: As mentioned before, unexpectedly, the model that yields better results in the original paper is not the best in our experiments. FFHQ results independently challenge performance under alternative training and architecture choices; Cartoon-only findings are not used as robustness evidence.
